Coram : V. RAMASUBRAMANIAN*, PANKAJ MITHAL
Wakf – Suit land was declared as wakf property by Single Judge – Order set aside by Division Bench – Held: Under the Muslim law, a wakf can be created in several ways but primarily by permanent dedication of any movable and professing Islam for any purpose recognized by Muslim law as pious, religious or charitable purpose and in the absence of such dedication, it can be presumed to have come into existence by long use – In the present case, on the admitted facts, the wakf by dedication of the suit land is
